tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies WebSocket connectivity to backend.

tools.name: admin-infra-backend-status
tools.description: Get current status of the Teros backend including uptime, memory usage, process info, and number of running MCAs.

tools.name: admin-infra-restart-backend
tools.description: Restart the Teros backend server. Runs a fast pre-flight (audit who holds the backend port, kill any orphan non-pm2 listener left over from a previous restart), triggers the graceful restart, and returns IMMEDIATELY on 200 — it does NOT wait or poll, because this MCA dies with the backend seconds after the restart starts. The conversation resumes automatically when the backend is back (system_resume); FIRST ACTION on wake: call admin-infra-backend-status and verify the listener (pm2 descent) and, when expectedCommit was passed, that the served commit matches. Use with caution - this will temporarily interrupt service.

confirm.description: Confirmation flag - must be true to proceed with restart

expectedCommit.description: Optional git commit (sha) the restarted backend is expected to serve — pass it after a git pull/checkout. It is NOT verified in-call (impossible: the MCA dies with the backend); it is echoed back so the agent can verify it via admin-infra-backend-status as its first action on wake.

tools.name: admin-infra-sync
tools.description: Sync MCAs, models, and tools from filesystem to database. Run this after adding or modifying MCAs.

tools.name: admin-infra-mca-status
tools.description: Get status of all running MCA processes. Super admin only.

tools.name: admin-infra-mca-kill
tools.description: Kill a running MCA process by appId. Super admin only. DESTRUCTIVE — use with caution.

appId.description: The appId of the MCA process to kill (e.g., 'app_51a87881c58035ce', from admin-infra-mca-status)

tools.name: admin-infra-mca-cleanup
tools.description: Clean up stale or dead MCA processes. Super admin only. DESTRUCTIVE — use with caution.

tools.name: admin-infra-mca-health
tools.description: Run health checks on all MCA processes. Super admin only. By default force-spawns dormant (standby) MCAs so the check is real — set forceSpawn:false for a cheap read-only snapshot of already-running MCAs.

forceSpawn.description: Spawn dormant (standby) MCAs before checking them. Default true. With false, dormant MCAs are reported as unknown and are NOT started.
